remarks:
Welcome to 246 74th Street, a complete renovation taken down to the original wood frame and rebuilt from the ground up. The home features new walls, wiring, plumbing, insulation, drywall, and heating, along with new windows, siding, roofing, and driveway. All work was performed by licensed contractors, meets 2026 code, and has been fully permitted and inspected.

The wide new driveway accommodates any vehicle and leads back to a spacious private yard. A new fence now runs the full perimeter of the property, and the yard has been freshly seeded with Kentucky Bluegrass sod. A concrete patio sits just off the rear of the house, ideal for outdoor seating or entertaining. The purchase includes a gate for the yard, with placement determined by the buyer, allowing the space to be fully enclosed.

Inside, the first floor opens into a bright living room with large windows, recessed lighting, and high ceilings. The kitchen offers generous cabinet space, custom countertops, a built-in microwave, a dishwasher, recessed lighting, and ample outlets. Luxury vinyl plank flooring runs seamlessly through the main living areas, while the bedrooms feature high-end carpeting for added comfort. At the rear of the home, the formal dining room overlooks the backyard.

A wide hallway leads to a first-floor bedroom and up to the private primary suite, which offers generous closet space and recessed lighting. Every room in the home is properly insulated, with all work inspected and permitted. small amount of square footage added by renovators.

The property comes with a 3-year warranty, and the seller is including select custom finishes at no additional cost. This home is move-in ready.
